features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: ImportPanel now opens a native OS file dialog (dialog:pickFile IPC channel, filtered to .txt/.md) since Electron 33 removed renderer File.path. DocumentService.importDocument validates extension and 10MB max size and surfaces errors in the UI. Covered by src/services/document-service.test.ts (import .txt, import .md, reject bad extension, reject oversized file); npm run check and npm run build both pass.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: Added documents:getContent IPC channel (main/preload/DocumentService.getDocumentContent already existed) and wired DocumentDetail to load and render it alongside existing metadata and delete button. Fixed a bug where deleteDocument left the content/<id>.txt file behind after delete. Covered by src/services/document-service.test.ts ('deletes a document and its content'); npm run check and npm run build both pass.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: App now loads the document list on startup (useEffect in App.tsx) instead of only on manual refresh, so persisted state is visible immediately after a restart. PersistenceService writes are now genuinely atomic (temp file + rename) as ARCHITECTURE.md claims. Verified with src/services/document-service.test.ts and persistence-service.test.ts, which simulate a restart by re-instantiating the services against the same data directory and confirm documents/content/state survive; npm run check and npm run build both pass.
